data.body:
Scope was narrowed after the code review gate caught a defect in the first revision of the fix. That revision skipped orphan reclamation for PR_CREATED and AWAITING_PR_CLOSE. Investigation showed the skip was wrong in both cases. count_active_runs counts every non-terminal row against the platform concurrency cap, and is_live returns false only on NOT_FOUND while raising on every other RPC error. An AWAITING_PR_CLOSE workflow is live by design, blocked on await_resume, so the liveness check already covers it and the skip only leaked a slot when such a workflow genuinely died. A PR_CREATED run on the path that does not await close has completed and returned at draft_pull_request.py line 2323, so skipping it leaked a slot on every successful run. The skip was removed.

Final state on head 364b961. Full inv ci green with 1457 passed, 6 skipped, eval-gate PASS. Plan review PASS and signed. Code review PASS with zero blocking and zero advisory, attested at 364b961. GitHub CI pass in 3m6s on pull request 27.

Plan review raised one advisory noting that the active query acceptance criteria read as implementation detail against the problem statement. Left as written because the description motivates carrying the state through to the reclamation reason, which is what the query change serves.
